# Utter

> Utter is a local, context-aware voice-to-desktop-action assistant for Linux
> (Wayland; niri and KDE Plasma first-class) and macOS natively.
> It turns spoken commands into desktop actions. Speech recognition, the
> decision and vision models and the screenshots run locally: no account, no
> telemetry, offline by default.

Canonical site: https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/
Source: https://github.com/sujaisubbanna/utter-assistant
License: Apache-2.0
Languages: English (default), Spanish, German, Japanese (machine-drafted docs);
the settings app and installer ship 10 UI locales.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/introduction/): what Utter is, the rules-first design, and how it decides what to do.
- [Getting started](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/getting-started/): the two push-to-talk keys, picking a first model, the two modes and sleep mode.
- [Demo](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/demo/): a 47-second hands-free clip.

## Install

- [Install overview](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/install/): the ways to install on Linux and macOS.
- [Install from the web](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/install/remote/): the one-line installer, every flag and environment variable.
- [Clone and build from source](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/install/from-source/): the developer installer, systemd user services and building the settings app.
- Hosted installer: https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/install.sh

## Guides

- [Configuration](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/configuration/): every knob in ~/.config/utter/config.toml.
- [Apps and actions](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/apps-and-actions/): how spoken commands become desktop actions and app profiles.
- [Models](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/models/): the model store and recommendations per GPU class.
- [Trust and safety](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/trust-and-safety/): provenance tagging, confirmation and permissions.
- [Theming](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/theming/): matugen (Material You) palette integration.
- [Noctalia widget and OSD](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/noctalia/): the optional bar widget and on-screen display.
- [KDE Plasma](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/kde-plasma/): the KWin/Wayland backend.
- [macOS](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/guides/macos/): native speech, Quartz push-to-talk and injection.

## Plugins

- [Plugin protocol](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/plugins/): JSON-RPC framing, handshake, manifests, capabilities and streams.
- [Writing a plugin](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/plugins/writing-a-plugin/): a worked minimal plugin in Python and Rust.

## Help

- [Troubleshooting](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/help/troubleshooting/): fixes for common problems.
- [FAQ](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/help/faq/): short answers to common questions.

## Reference

- [Architecture](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/reference/architecture/): runner, protocol, plugin taxonomy and trust boundaries.
- [The utter CLI (agents)](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/reference/cli-agent/): drive Utter from the command line with a stable JSON contract.
- [The assistant CLI](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/reference/cli-assistant/): doctor, recommend, models, status and install-state.
- [Releasing](https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/reference/releasing/): how releases, the installer and this site are built and published.

## Translations (machine-drafted, unreviewed)

- Spanish: https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/es/
- German: https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/de/
- Japanese: https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/ja/

Pages without a translation fall back to English under the locale prefix (for
example https://utter.sujaisubbanna.com/de/guides/configuration/ serves the
English page with a notice).
